No indication it's interactive. Toggling it changes nothing in the accessibility tree. Neither exists here. **Cognitive accessibility**: Interaction model is mouse-dependent only. No consistent pattern across devices. Missing heading structure breaks document outline navigation. --- ### Verdict Justification The component fails core accessibility design requirements for interactive widgets.
